note: Primitive area in a wooded point between two coves on Toronto Lake's northeast shore, off K-105; gravel drive-in sites. A firsthand review notes trees screen the lake from the sites. --Claude
summary: campitks per-site: 15 primitive gravel back-ins, 36-80 ft, vault toilet only; open year round; 14-night/2027 holiday rule; fees reshaped (prime site 404 +$2, stray electric:0 surcharge removed). Not waterfront kept (campitks Lake View tags vs canopy). Website: swap reserveamerica link for campitks.
flags: WATERFRONT: stored NOT WATERFRONT kept. campitks tags all 15 'River/Lake View: Y' and 'Within 1/8 Mile', but on imagery (Esri leaf-off and NAIP summer, per-site coordinates) the sites sit on the spine of a wooded point 45-100 m from either cove through continuous trees, and the existing note cites a firsthand review saying the trees screen the lake. A leaf-off winter view from 404-406 at the west end is possible; LAKEVIEW is the most it could be, and I would not raise it on a booking-site tag.
